Wednesday WPRI 12 Weather Now 3/17/26 Sunny Chilly Wednesday WPRI 12 Weather Now 3/17/26 Sunny Chilly Wednesday Providence councilors pass historic rent-control … The Providence City Council gave its first approval of a controversial rent-control ordinance Thursday night in a 9-6 vote. ‘I feel him with me’: Narragansett mom to run in … The 130th Boston Marathon is just three weeks away. Spotlight New England: Guest Mayara Maciel, owner … Spotlight New England airs weekdays at 12:30 p.m. on the WPRI 12+ TV app and WPRI.com. Community Focus: Globe RI’s Christopher Gavin talks … Globe Rhode Island Reporter Christopher Gavin joins 12 News at 4 to discuss the reorganization happening in the Diversity, Equity and Inclusion office and the concerns faculty raised about the move. Jury to decide fate of Seekonk man accused of attacking … Testimony has wrapped in the trial of a Seekonk man facing multiple charges, including kidnapping and attempted rape, as jurors prepare to begin deliberations. 3 state troopers plead not guilty to charges connected … A supervisor and two instructors with a Massachusetts State Police tactical unit plead not guilty Thursday in connection with the death of a recruit who suffered a concussion during a sparring session and blunt force injuries a day later in what investigators called an “unapproved and unsafe” boxing match. Police still looking for car involved in deadly Providence … The Providence Police Department is still searching for the car believed to be involved in a deadly hit-and-run last month. What is ‘concierge medicine’ and why more doctors … "Membership medicine" is a growing trend for doctors to charge a patient a subscription fee with the promise of better access to care, but many are worried it will price people out of having a doctor all together. Petition grows to save controversial Providence mural … An online petition with more than 10,000 signatures is pushing to preserve a disputed mural tied to a high-profile killing, as city leaders and the property owner stand by the decision to remove it. Rain forecasted for Easter, Passover weekend As many across the state are gearing up to travel or host family for Easter weekend, the rain in the forecast could force some to alter their plans. Coventry police ask for help finding hit-and-run … Coventry police are looking for the public’s help finding a driver involved in a hit-and-run on Arnold Road. How the ‘Real Housewives’ franchise can help RI economy 12 News Consumer Reporter Sarah Guernelli spoke to people across the state who say it's not just about the drama, but a chance to show the rest of the country what the Ocean State has to offer.
